input: Find summer camps that have already announced 2027 dates for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Mars Hill Cycling Camp
candidates.note: Ages 10–18; road/gravel June 14–19 and mountain biking June 21–26, 2027, with additional mountain-bike sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Celo
candidates.note: Coed farm and outdoor camp for ages 7–12; official 2027 dates-and-rates page published.

candidates.name: Camp Spring Creek
candidates.note: Ages 7–15 with dyslexia; six-week boarding session June 20–July 31, 2027.

candidates.name: Baptists on Mission
candidates.note: Deep Impact youth mission camps: Marion June 14–18 and Spruce Pine July 19–23, 2027.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: 2027 residential sessions June 13–July 30; day camps June–August, plus riding, biking and leadership programs.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Boys in grades 1–11; 2027 overnight sessions June 7–August 12.

candidates.name: Piedmont Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Bud Schiele: 2027 Scouts BSA guides published; Cub Scout resident camp July 7–10, 2027.

candidates.name: Camp Lurecrest
candidates.note: Rising grades 3–12; eight residential sessions June 20–August 6, 2027.

candidates.name: Trejo Soccer Academy
candidates.note: July 12–16, 2027 at Legacy Soccer Park; morning ages 6–10 and evening ages 11–18.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: Bluegrass, Old-Time and Roots Music camp for ages 12–19, July 5–9, 2027; commuter or residential options.

candidates.name: Grace Fellowship Church of Johnson City
candidates.note: Pine Cove day camp for rising grades 1–6, June 28–July 2, 2027.
